query: I'm buying an electric car next month with a loan. What tax benefit do I get?

benefits.note: Loan must have been sanctioned between 2019-01-01 and 2023-03-31.

benefits.reason: Scheme does not cover electric cars; e-2W and e-3W only.

result.regime_note: 80EEB is available only under the old regime; user is on the new regime.

output_text:
Two things to flag before you buy.

Section 80EEB would have given you a deduction of up to ₹1,50,000 on the loan interest, but the sanction window closed on 31 March 2023 — loans sanctioned after that date do not qualify. It is also an old-regime deduction, and you are on the new regime, so it would not have applied to you in any case.

PM E-DRIVE does not cover electric cars; the demand incentive is limited to two- and three-wheelers.

On cost: GST on electric vehicles is 5%, so on a base price of ₹18,00,000 you pay ₹90,000 GST, giving a landed cost of ₹18,90,000 before registration and insurance. Figures as of 9 August 2026.
